# sonarqube_server (Data Source)

Version, edition and status of the server, e.g. to gate configuration on edition.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_server" "this" {}

output "sonarqube_version" {
  value = data.sonarqube_server.this.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `edition` (String) `community`, `developer`, `enterprise` or `datacenter`.
- `id` (String) Server ID.
- `status` (String) Server status, e.g. `UP`.
- `version` (String) Server version, e.g. `26.11.0.134175`.
